page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes in the right margin, too faint and cut off by the facing page to read, so they are not transcribed.

main_text.p: Marc.2.7. Lucæ 5.21. Remittunt & Ministri peccata, sed tanquam tettes, & Dei instrumenta, & hanc authoritatem a Christo acceptam habent, Matt.16.19. Ioan.20.23. Quia plures locos eodem tempore occupat, Matth.18.20. & 28.20. Ioan.1.18. & 3.13. & 14.23. Atqui id solius Dei est, 1. Reg. 8.27. 2. Paral. 2.5. & 6.18. Iob.11.8. Psal.139.v.7.8.9.10. Esa.6.3. & 66.1. Ier.23.24. Amos 9.2. Sap.1.7. Matt.5.35. Act.7.48.8. 17.24. Quia potestate eadem qua Pater, pollet, Ioan.5.v.17. 19. & 16.15. Quia potestatem miracula edendi conferit Matt.10.8. Mar.6.7. & 16.17. Lucæ 10.19. Ioan.14.12. Act.3. v.6.12.16. & 14.3. Quia resurrectionis autor est, Ioan.5.v.21. 25. & 6. v.39.40.44.54. & 11.25. 1. Cor.15.21. Quia Rex Regum, & Dominus dominantium, Apoc.19.16. quod Paulus Patri tribuit, 1. Tim.6.15. Eiusdem ergo potentiæ Christus cum Patre. Quia Seruator est, & dicitur, Matt.1.21. Actor.4. 12.1. Ioan.4.14. Tit.1.v.3.4. & 2.13. Atqui hoc non nisi vere Iehouæ competit, Esa.44.11. & 45.22. Quòd autem hæc appellatio Ministris etiam verbi tribuitur, Abd.v.21. 1. Tim. 4.16. Iac.5.20. eò fit, quia illi sunt administri salutis per Evangelicam doctrinam, 1. Corin.3.9. & 4.11. Quia Evangelium, quod testimonium Dei dicitur, 1. Cor.2.1. dicitur Christi testimonium, 1. Cor.1.6. Quia sperare dicuntur gentes in eo, Esai.11.10. Paulo interprete, Rom.15.12. & beati dicuntur, qui sperant in eum, Psal.2.12. Atqui maledictus, qui spem suam locat in homine, Ier.17.v.57. beatus contra, qui fidit Deo, Psal.84.13. Quia suscitauit seipsum, Rom.1.4. Ioan. 10.18. Quia Spiritum S. mittit, Zach 12.10. Ioan.16.7. & 20. 22. Quia virtus eius diuinos effectus habet, Rom.15.v.18.19. 2. Cor.12.9. Hebr.1.3. Quia vita fuisse in Christo dicitur Ioan.1.4. Atqui in solo Deo viuunt, mouentur, & subsistunt omnia, Actor.17.28. Rom.11.36. 1. Cor.8.6. Quia vnu essentia cum Patre, Ioan.1.18. & 5.18. & 8.38. & 14.v.10.20. Philip.2.6.
Quarto, ab effectu vniuersali, videlicet ὃς ἐκ πάσης κτίσεως ἡ δημιουργίας, à creatione & conseruatione rerum omnium: quia creator, Ioan.1.3. & 5.17. Col.1.16. Heb.1.v.2. 10. Apoc.3.14.

Quinto, à cultu, quem omnes fideles inde vsque ab orbe condito Filio Dei Christo, vt vero & natura Deo exhibuerunt: Quia adorandus, Psal.97.7. Heb.1.6. Luc.24.52. Ioan.23. Phil.2.10. Apoc.4.v.8.9.10.11. Atqui Deus solus est adorandus, Deut.6.13. & 10.20. Matt.4.10. Luc.4.8. Actor.14.

page.notes: Marginal notes in the right margin are faint and partly hidden by the facing page; they could not be read and are not transcribed. Greek phrase in the fourth paragraph is uncertain: "ὃς ἐκ πάσης κτίσεως ἡ δημιουργίας" [?]. Last line of the page is partly cut off at the gutter edge.
